_comment: Adjudicated tool diagnostic IDs (vibe-ic#1081). An ID listed here is one a
human LOOKED AT and decided we accept, so `tool_diagnostic_id_gate.py` does
not block on it appearing for the first time.
THIS LIST IS ITSELF CHECKED. `audit_acceptance()` blocks on three things,
because an allowlist nobody re-examines becomes a check that lies:
1. MALFORMED - every entry needs id, reason, accepted_on, expires_on and
adjudicated_by. An exemption nobody signed or dated is not an
adjudication, it is a silence with a JSON key.
2. EXPIRED - past `expires_on` is BLOCKING, not auto-renewed and not
quietly dropped. Expiry has to cost something or it is decoration.
3. STALE - the ID is emitted nowhere in the current run. An exemption
that outlived the diagnostic it excused is the same shape
`retention.json` already blocks on for published cells.
THE COMPARISON PATH IS REACHABLE, and this file used to say the opposite.
Re-measured on the tree this file ships in: 8 recognised run dirs under
`benchmark-data/ic/`, and ONE comparable pair -
sha256/clean_run_v1427_20260715  vs  sha256/clean_run_v1422_20260715
-> rc 1, blocking on DRT-0120 in reports/phase3/drc_router.rpt
so the gate has a LIVE un-adjudicated finding and this list is still empty.
That combination is deliberate and is the point of the file: the author must
not adjudicate his own finding. DRT-0120 stays un-accepted until somebody
with the standing to accept it writes a reason, a date and a name. Adding it
here to make a run green would be the exact defect this gate exists to
remove.
AND THE PARAGRAPH ABOVE IS CHECKED RATHER THAN TRUSTED, because the claim it
replaced was prose that had quietly stopped being true.
`test_the_acceptance_records_REACHABILITY_claim_is_measured` recomputes the
pair count from the corpus and fails in BOTH directions: while a pair exists
this file must not claim unreachability, and if the corpus ever loses its
last pair the disclosure must come back. Neither state can be reached by
editing this text alone.
WHAT THIS FILE CLAIMED BEFORE, WITHDRAWN RATHER THAN QUIETLY EDITED - twice.
(1) The FIRST draft read that `spm/v1.9.94_sky130A` vs `v1.5.65_sky130A`
emits DRT-0290, EST-0015, ODB-0220, STA-0168, STA-0198, and that
`spm/v1.9.96_gf180mcuD` adds DRT-0349, DRT-0701, PSM-0079. Neither
`v1.9.94_sky130A` nor `v1.5.65_sky130A` exists in this repository, so
the COMPARISON said to surface them never ran here. (The ids are real
shapes - STA-0168 and STA-0198 are `Warning 168:` and `Warning 198:`
in the aging_sta/power reports.)
(2) The SECOND draft corrected that to 'every one of the five published
cells exits 2 NO_BASELINE ... the comparison path is unreachable from
today's corpus', and added 'when a second same-PDK cell is published,
the gate will produce a real list'. That was an honest measurement of
a BROKEN RESOLVER, mistaken for a fact about the population. The PDK
was being parsed out of the directory NAME, so the repository's
`clean_run_*` family was invisible and the one genuinely like-for-like
pair was skipped. No publish was needed - a code fix reached it.
Both are kept because the SHAPE of the mistake is the useful part: an
unreachable-comparison disclosure reads identically whether the population
really has no pair or the resolver merely cannot see one.
Shape of an entry:
{"id": "RSZ-0062", "reason": "why we accept it",
"adjudicated_by": "who decided"}
